exposure: Pregnant women with suspected COVID-19 pneumonia
Pregnant women with confirmed COVID-19 pneumonia
cohort: Pregnant women in their third trimester admitted to labor between January 24 and February 29, 2020
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 pneumonia who delivered vaginally or via cesarean section did not experience severe maternal or neonatal complications.
mod_finding: The majority of women with COVID-19 pneumonia had cesarean deliveries (34 out of 34).
